reviews.text: Hi, Leticia. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

Really good people who actually care.......
Recommend to everyone.

Me and my pup love Dr Nick at Uptown! He is so intentional and patient with my puppy and all my questions! All of the staff are lovely and clearly care about animals and making everyone comfortable! My only concern is the scheduling policies. I intentionally scheduled a follow up with Dr Nick a few weeks ago to discuss a plan for neutering. I scheduled at the desk and got several confirmations via txt and email that I had my appointment.  When I got in at the time of appointment I was told I “had not confirmed” and therefore my spot was given to someone else. This is very frustrating as it did not say in any of the reminders that I needed to confirm or that my appointment was at risk of being given away. The staff was very understanding and it was all resolved! But it was very stressful. Every time I’m seen I also have an appointment show up for 6months in the future that I did not schedule. This is frustrating as well because I have to go through all the steps to cancel it.

I am always scared to try new places in fear of it just not being good.  I will say I had a 5 star experience at GoodVets Uptown.  Super clean rooms, friendly helpful staff, good prices, and they explain everything and are very caring people.

There was no long wait.   I was able to book an appointment being a new customer and get one the next morning with no hassle.

If you are in the uptown area take you pets here!

I enjoy GoodVets because of the staff. We are always greeted and treated well. I am able to get seen promptly and they take time to listen to any questions or concerns. My dog also enjoys going and that says a whole lot. Especially when he is usually getting an allergy shot and anal glands expressed. I really appreciate how patient and understanding the staff is with my anxious dog. Especially his vet, Dr. Nick Yohanna who is absolutely patient, friendly and so wonderful with him.
Hi, Oliwia. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

I usually go to the location by Fullerton but this one was an emergency. My dog Miranda lambert is really old and I took her to the beach and she wouldn’t stop peeing inside my home or lobby it was stressful few days. We took her and they saved her life. She had a uti. At first they quote us for something else but end up paying less. I would sell my kidney for this dog.  This chain  always has the right people to give the right  diagnosis .  Thank you everyone now my baby sleeping like a angel

Incredibly kind and knowledgeable! As a first time cat owner both the technician and vet were happy to answer all of my questions and help me feel well equipped to take the best care of my new furry friend!
Excellent care for my 17 year old poodle.
Hi, Eric. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for trusting us with your pet!
Hi, G.  Thank you so much for your kind review and trust with your furry family member. We look forward to seeing you both again soon!

everyone is so nice and professional from the receptionist to the assistant doctor and the doctor i felt very comfortable and they were all nice and patient with my dog i well definitely keep going there no doubt about it
Best veterinary experience I've ever had. Staff was quick, friendly, and professional. They were great with our dog, and communicated clearly with us. Service was excellent, price was reasonable.
Dr. Brian Youk is amazing!!! Mochi and Maui loves him. They are not scared during their vet visits. I have been very happy with GoodVets in Uptown.
very personable, quick service and it feels like they really care
Very good care and response time to my dog's needs. Thorough check up was appreciated. Same day appointment is a good plus. Will consider coming back again if needed.
Hi, Rachel. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Hi, Elizabeth. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for trusting us with your pet!
Hi, John. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Hi, Stephanie. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

Easy to make appointments, was on time to examine our dog, and ready to share vet info with our vet care in another home state.  Our vetinarian was very informative and clear in explaining what was going on and what we may expect going forward.  She answered all our questions and gave us options from which to choose for treatment.
There is a reason my little guy is 17 years old. Good vet care. Thank you to everyone at GoodVets for always treating Monkey with love and respect. You guys are the best!

Today was my first appointment at GoodVets Uptown and I couldn't be happier with my experience. The office is very well maintained and there is plenty of space in the waiting area. Every staff member I interacted with was so kind with plenty of smiles to go around. The technicians were so gentle and took such great care of her when it was time to go back for her vaccinations, blood draw, and nail trim. And finally, the vet that we saw, Dr. Youk, was so attentive; I didn't feel like we were just another appointment. 11/10 I highly recommend GoodVets Uptown!

Also, I highly recommend taking advantage of the Care Plans they have available.

Staff and doctors are always so compassionate and caring. You can tell how much they love animals, as they handled my sassy girl with such patience and understanding. I love the calming atmosphere as well, and they provide clear explained cost estimates before proceeding with any treatment. The best vet I’ve ever been to!
Our dog was suffering from seasonal allergies. We were able to schedule an appointment and get excellent care.

The staff at this location are wonderful. From the front desk staff, to the technicians, and of course Dr. Nick. He was so good with my Bella. Bella had a pretty bad experience at Companion Skokie and has been super nervous at vets ever since. Nick was able to calm her down and get her out of her shell so he could do a comprehensive exam.
very thoughtful and empathetic in helping me understand and deal with bad news
Amazing experience from beginning to end. Welcoming, clean and extremely patient and transparent doctor Nick. Would absolutely recommend the clinic to anyone!

Update: My new kitties Kloee and Pippa are also patients of Uptown Good Vets. The staff is always friendly, patient, and welcoming. Dr. Yohanna has a clam, confident voice and demeanor which helps keep pet and owner stress minimized. This is unequivocally the best veterinary clinic I’ve ever used.

Regardless of what lies Kitty told me when we got home, I know she has never had a better veterinary office experience. All of the staff is patient and obviously full of care for animals. I was worried I wasn’t able to help Kitty recover properly from her pancreatitis and UTI, but regardless of how busy they were, room was made for Kitty to stay and be taken care of professionally. Thanks to Drs. Trefil and Wilson and team Kitty is back to her judgmental, sassy self.
I’m still not ruling out this whole “sickness” as just a rouse to get me to spend money as punishment for something evil she believes I did to her. Cats…
Always a great experience good vets informed about any issues and then follow up emails.
Friendly, welcoming. My cat is the demon seed of Satan yet the Vet + staff bravely handled her humanely.  Many thanks for services rendered.

Dr Jermolowicz is amazing and such a kind and caring vet. We bring both of our pets to her!
Dr Jermolowicz and her staff went above and beyond during one of our worst times, the passing of our Luna. They were so caring and we are grateful she was in good hands during her last moments.

Just visited today with my daughter Bibble and the  vet was very informative and helpful. He make sure to address all of my concern and was able to give me some recommendations! Bibble also got a shot and she’s doing well so far!
No wait. Explain prices well. Did not feel disrespected because I couldn’t afford everything.
No waiting time on a Sunday. Courteous and attentive service.

I brought my dog in for an emergency visit after he injured his foot and was later told he had a broken ankle that would require surgical repair possibly with plates. As you can imagine, this was already a very stressful situation, and I was trying to act quickly to get him the care he needed.

After being told surgery was necessary but could not be performed at this clinic, I immediately contacted  my vet a hour & a half away who was able to perform surgery. This vet clinic asked for the x-rays right away so they could prepare. I requested multiple times that my dog’s x-rays be sent over and was repeatedly told they had been sent, but the receiving clinic confirmed more than once that they had not received anything. This caused unnecessary delays in an already urgent situation.

While trying to coordinate between both vets, I had the other clinic on the phone and was actively waiting on the phone with me till the x-rays were sent. Instead of being helpful when the second vet wasn’t receiving the x-rays Goodvets staff became defensive and dismissive when I explained that the files had not gone through. There was a clear lack of urgency and accountability, which is extremely concerning in an emergency setting.

The billing was also extremely questionable. I was initially quoted $547 for the emergency visit and x-rays. However, when I went to check out so I could leave and drive to another clinic for surgery, my bill had increased to $998. This included charges for services that had not yet been completed, specifically a specialist review of the x-rays that I was still waiting on. I had to question these charges in order for them to even be acknowledged.

What was most upsetting was the way I was treated when I asked for clarification. The veterinarian was dismissive, visibly frustrated, rolled his eyes, and told me I was “wasting my time” and to “leave.” At no point did I feel supported or taken seriously, despite the fact that my dog had a confirmed fracture and needed urgent surgical care. At this point everyone in the office who worked there kept saying “today is a bad day”. very reassuring.

I understand that clinics are busy and high-pressure environments, but that does not excuse poor communication, inaccurate billing, or lack of basic professionalism and compassion. In a situation where timing, clarity, and coordination are critical, this experience fell far below expectations.

I ultimately had to leave without confidence that anything had been properly handled and seek care elsewhere. When i got to the second vet they told me nothing was broken & he had torn a ligament.  IF THESE PEOPLE CANNOT READ X-RAYS CORRECTLY THEY SHOULD NOT BE RELYING ANY INFO TO THEIR PATIENTS !!!! EXTREMELY UNPROFESSIONAL!!!!!!!
I would strongly caution others to consider this before coming here, especially for urgent situations.

Garbage vet... I absolutely can't stand these people.. my dog is constantly getting there prescription declined by these guys.. I've stopped going to them entirely.
#2 issue is I've had 2 vets "scared" of my dog the things big but she's an absolute baby... DONT become a vet if your scared of animals. I've stopped bringing both my dogs there.
Efficient, informative, and empathic service. My cat was diagnosed on the spot. A few weeks into her treatment plan, she is back to her normal healthy self. I am so, so grateful.

My dog Lady and I love The staff at GoodVets - Uptown… especially Dr. Nick.
From the start, we have received compassionate, thorough and knowledgeable care from everyone from front desk staff, vet assistants and doctor. I highly recommend this place to any dog/ owner that has had issues finding the right veterinary care.

My dog finds it difficult to trust new people because she is an older rescue.
Excellent place. So happy I listened to my neighbor and tried them.

I really love GoodVets Uptown. My puppy, Billie, has had her fair share of stomach drama, and they’ve been so kind, patient, and helpful through all of it. Super easy to get an appointment and the hours are awesome. Dr. Haley is wonderful and Emily deserves a medal for answering my endless questions with so much patience and kindness. Everyone is easy to talk to, explains things in a way that actually makes sense, and clearly really cares. Billie is lucky to have them, and honestly, so am I.
The nurses and doctors are stellar! I truly appreciate all the care, support, and excellent service they provide. They are so kind and compassionate. My fur daughter absolutely loves them! 🐾 …
Theresa was a great help with me and my pet cat the other day.  She gave excellent service in providing what information I needed in setting up with my appointment. Very kind and professional.

Really amazing how badly they fumbled me as a client, much less as a human being. They trick you into their "wellness plan" which is basically just your yearly spend spread out into semi-equal payments. Most of it is not needed, you could just pay for it as you go and is simply an avenue for them to siphon money out of you.

DENTAL CLEANING
- Part of the deal is that you're paying for certain services, one of which happens to be a dental cleaning. A front desk receptionist happily told me I would be unable to schedule a dental cleaning, a service I paid for, because my wellness plan was expiring. As to why that mattered at all is lost on me: I paid for the service, I should receive the service in kind, regardless of whether or not the wellness plan is expiring.
- If I had known you'd have to physically get it done (which was never communicated to me) before the year deadline was up, I would have scheduled accordingly.
- I say all of this, because I had asked a few times about dental cleaning and they said to push it closer to the end of the year. When the end of year finally came, they pushed back via the receptionist and said it was completely unavailable.
- There was no follow-up, no "your benefits are expiring, schedule now to redeem" message, no inclination whatsoever that even though you had $135 yanked from your account all year, it was actually all a ruse and you don't actually get that service.

WELLNESS CHECK
In addition to all of that, there was another time where my pup was due for a wellness check. It's part of the program and it was his mid-year check-up. One of the technicians, I think a reviewer below said her hair was badly dyed red (can confirm!) was standoffish and said that wasn't true and turned me away. I turned around and booked an appointment through the app and the vet was happy to see me, completely opposite from the burnt hair individual's guidance.

AND FINALLY...
Adding to the litany of issues with GoodVets, they scheduled a monthly gland expression for my pup, which I later found out from the lovely vets at FAUNA down the street that that was negligent and, of course, uncomfortable for my pup. They said they would schedule (and did) a remedy to fix that from being a monthly occurrence, but his glands didn't need to be expressed that often and was just another way for them to get more $$$ from me.

TL;DR | Stay far away from this place unless you hate your pet and love wasting money.
Duke loves coming here - even he’s misbehaving, he’s always treated with patience and love. Amazing staff.
The door is always busted and front desk girls are either angels, or the one tech with red box dyed hair from Wal Mart has an attitude.

I used to take the my senior dog to them about a year ago, before she passed. She was on the wellness plan and it was always a delight, she loved going to the back. They always explained what was happening and the aftercare instructions of all her procedures. She has since passed and I moved to another state but they would be a solid recommendation for anyone in the area.

Updated to say: they will send you to collections without notifying you of any outstanding balance, will ignore your calls and ghost you. I had NO idea my credit card had declined the transaction, no email, physical mail or phone call was made to notify me of this, instead 3 years after my last visit I got a very angry call from collections and goodvets straight up ghoted me :)

Sploot isn’t my regular vet, but my vet wanted an astronomical amount of money to put my sweet baby boy of 16 years down, so I went to Sploot. Of course I was so devastated and sad and scared. My heart was broken. The team and the doctor at this place were so kind, so sympathetic, and so supportive, I can’t put it into words how grateful I am for their gentle care and kindness. The card they sent was personalized even though they met us once and  I teared up reading it. Thank you all for being so wonderful. Please go see them if you’re looking for amazing people that love what they do ❤️
The Vet and Vet Tech were both so kind. I felt well informed and that my dog was being cared for so sweetly
Good Service, and they share knowledge
Everyone was sweet, and very welcoming
Whole process from booking to checking out was seamless which I appreciate since it was an emergency. Will be back for wellness visits once we establish care!

Like other Goodvets locations constantly misses very important details resulting major (and expensive) inconveniences. Coordination between staff and vets within the same location is very poor. Coordination between different locations is almost non-existent. (The staff is polite and friendly but not after lapses.)
Our healthy Kitty's routine testings and vaccinations exceeded $700. A majority of cat owners can't afford quality care.

Dr. Yohanna went above and beyond taking care of our Yorkie. He listened to my concerns and worries about her being put under. He communicated with me throughout her procedure and even worked with my schedule so I could see her before a scheduled flight. Thank you so much Dr Yohanna! We appreciate the GoodVets team and everything they do!
They were nice to my dog.
Dr. Yohanna is amazing!

Honestly the staff here is all amazing except for the Vets themselves. There was a time when one vet (Dr.Zach) was very attentive, inquisitive and gave great advice! The rest of the staff is very sweet and has been nothing but amazing with my dog.

However, the other vets don’t do their due diligence in asking questions or have the amount of knowledge that other vets have. They tried to charge me for a dog drop off, xray, shots etc. without even seeing me & my dog. Because their vet were busy with all day surgery that day and I came in for a walk-in appointment bc my dog was vomiting. This was quite unprofessional of them to suggest these things and cost me more money bc they are busy all day.
I appreciate everyone in the office. Everyone is so kind and I have truly enjoyed my three visits to the office. The professionalism is top notch.

It was a very smooth visit and everyone was very kind and welcoming! I was pleasantly surprised how quickly my cat was seen, especially since this is our first time visiting. I certainly appreciate it, even at the end of the night everyone was great and made us feel comfortable. Thank you!
amazing team! everyone is kind and truly loves animals. great vet spot for cats and dogs :)
Thankyou Iris for being at Goodvets from dawn till dusk today and being so comforting!

Everyone from the Front Desk Staff to Vet Techs are so friendly and patient! Dr. Barichello is amazing - she always makes sure I leave feeling well informed and confident about moving forward with my daughter/cat's treatment plan!

Today, I brought in my 4 year old dachshund for routine dental work, and unexpected complications arose. They had to employ life saving measures, and due to the expertise and diligence of the entire staff, he survived with no long term complications expected. It is never guaranteed that CPR will work, but they successfully used it to save my dogs life without breaking ribs or causing physical trauma. That is not called luck- that is called expert staff. Deeply well trained, level headed, and prepared.

This adverse reaction to the medication could have happened anywhere, it was of no fault of any member of his care team.

Their ability to resuscitate and treat him was nothing short of miraculous, and brilliant. Bravo. Without the careful training of your team, my world would have shattered today. Instead, I have reason to celebrate. There are no words to describe my gratitude. I will always appreciate what you were able to do for our small family. Because of you, and your incredible team, our perfect boy will live to beg for cheese & kisses for a long time.

Thank you, eternally, GoodVets.

I am devastated by how my dog’s final moments were handled by Good Vets. When I brought my dog in during a critical emergency, I trusted that she would receive compassionate and professional care. Instead, I was met with pressure, manipulation, and ultimately deep regret.

Before my dog was put down, I made one simple, heartfelt request: that they provide a paw print as a keepsake. This meant everything to me. They told me it would be taken care of, but it never was. I never received the paw print, and that loss is something I’ll never be able to get back.

On top of that, during an incredibly emotional and vulnerable time, the staff repeatedly pushed me to apply for a credit card, something I now recognize as a form of predatory lending. Rather than helping me navigate a medical emergency, they seemed more interested in locking me into debt.

I believe their negligence and lack of urgency contributed to the death of my dog. I left feeling taken advantage of, ignored, and grieving not only the loss of my beloved pet, but also the way it was all handled. I would never recommend this place to anyone who truly loves their animal.
The doctors are so understanding w my anxious cat and my anxious self I love them

My dog’s had some pretty severe side effects from some dental work they did. My guess was a rushed anesthesiologist. But yea once I went to a real vet all my issues that were being dealt with by pain meds and “she’s just an old dog”-isms actually got some much needed attention.
Great Vet very good and great communication with the pet owner. Nice place and wonderful staff.

everybody there was so polite and kind and helped me out the moment. I walked in and got me situated and even helped me save money in the long run for future visits. Everyone was polite, friendly, warm and welcoming towards Jack and myself, and they helped answer all my questions and never rushed.

Been here twice with my dogs and both times it was a lovely experience. Twice had to find a vet that would see me short notice when something was wrong with the pups and after checking with multiple places I managed to get an appointment with them. Both times the doctors, the techs, and the front desk staff were super friendly, knowledgeable, and so very helpful. They all made sure they explained everything and listened to us, were super kind and attentive to our pups.
We do have a regular vet we frequent in the suburbs (significantly cheaper than those in the city, especially with older pups that need more stuff done) but I must say this place is amazing and I would highly recommend it.

We had a wonderful experience with Dr. Youk during Archer’s vet appointment. He was incredibly gentle and made sure Archer felt safe and comfortable the entire time. Dr. Youk’s knowledge and clear explanations gave us a lot of confidence that Archers skin rash will heal. Most of all, his genuine compassion and attentiveness really stood out. Highly recommend him to anyone looking for a caring and skilled veterinarian!

We had such a wonderful experience! Everyone was so friendly and welcoming. Our technician, Taylor (I think that's her name; she's the one with those awesome hand tattoos!), and Dr. Nicole were so attentive and shared lots of helpful information. My husband and I always want the best for our little Luca, and honestly, everything was just perfect-10 out of 10!
Thank you all so much!
Great experiment and very welcoming environment!

Highly recommend. The people who work here are kind, attentive, and a breeze to work with! I previously went to a vet who upsold me on everything and wanted to squeeze more money out of me, but I can tell that GoodVets Uptown is run with integrity. I had prepaid for a fecal sample test for my first cat but forgot to bring her sample in last year, and GoodVets allowed me to apply that unused payment to a new fecal sample test for my second cat. I appreciated that as well as their general transparency about pricing.
Love the wellness plan that covers what my dog needs for the year, don’t have to think too much about anything.
I've used GoodVets Uptown for two years. The staff is very friendly and helpful!
Pleasant staff, I love the pet insurance plan, and I feel like my dog is cared for. I've never had a bad experience!! Affordability and quality care.

I am very happy with the care, Veterinarians and all the staff. I trust them to care for my 18 year old Baby! I also trust the advice they give. Occasionally, I will go in and the bill will be high. However usually half of it is lab work. Everything is getting so expensive! Pets don’t cost a bunch when they are young. When they get older, it does get more expensive. But I love him!

Dr. Melin was phenomenal. As a first-time pet owner, I have many questions and tend to worry. Dr. Melin was incredibly patient and thorough, despite my kitten (Scout) not feeling well and being particularly uncomfortable/ unpleasant during her examination. She provided an excellent balance of information (research-based) and compassionate care.

I found this vet because it was very close to my house but I am very glad because they are amazing! Decided to do the puppy plan, which was super convenient and reasonably priced (for the city). She got spayed a couple of weeks ago and they were very thorough, communicative and helpful with any questions I had. Would definitely recommend them!
The vet office is very posh. The staff are very friendly. My dog loves going to the vet enough that she pulls her leash when we walk to the entrance.

Very nice facility. Clean also. Kpods, water and bubly shoud you want a refreshment. Greeted with a smile and a welcome. Check in was pretty fast, rooming was just as fast. Dr came in pretty fast. My questions were answered, i didnt feel rushed, my follow up appointment was scheduled for me all i had to do was check out and take my kitten home. So far so good.
I'm always happy with the service here from walking through the door being greeted with a smile to how fast we're brought to a room. The Drs, Techs go over everything that's going to happen with the visit, they show me the estimated cost for services and ask if I'm okay with that before proceeding. I've never had any issues with my feline after his visits, and the visits are thorough and I'm out the door in no time. The overall service Agree.
So caring and helpful. We were able to figure out a care plan that I could afford that still targeted the issue and got my cat feeling better.
vets were very detailed on his exam and handled my pet with great care.

Never coming back here. Went to follow up for a vaccine booster for my cat and left with a problem caused by staff. They were trying to get her out of her cage I was told also don't know why they didn't let me in with her and one of her claws got ripped off. Now she has to wear a cone. Then the nurse technician was trying to make it seem not as bad by making a mission impossible reference as a joke as if they didn't mess up or I would be less upset. I would have gotten more upset but I just wanted to get out of there before I really made a scene. This was only my second visit also. Terrible

Dear Vayda, 

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your positive experience and GoodVets Uptown. We are thrilled to hear that you were impressed with your visit and received excellent care. We appreciate the trust you placed in us and hope to continue serving you in the future. 

Best, 
GoodVets Uptown
Courteous staff.
I highly recommend GoodVets Uptown. The staff - from front desk to nurses, vets, and surgeons- is compassionate and skilled.

Dr. Yohanna and the GoodVets Uptown team were so wonderful to my senior lady, Lucy. We moved to Chicago earlier this year, and sadly, we lost Lucy in December after 19 beautiful years. Dr. Yohanna, Dr. Kim, Josh, Abbey, and the team all ensured her final days were filled with compassion and care, treating her with dignity and love. Dr. Yohanna especially, guided us through every step of managing her final days and keeping her comfortable.

I will always be grateful for the kindness shown by this location and the vets who showed care to my spicy yet sweet girl.

I appreciate the patience for how anxious and uncooperative my dog was, the appointment was quick and thorough and even though my dog wasn't happy to be at the vet, Dr.Trefil was really great with him.
Excellent vet practice! Very friendly staff and transparent/fair prices.
The location at Montrose and Clarendon is fabulous! Excellent customer service!!

Dr Yohanna is a superb clinician and has taken excellent care of my little baby girl, Callie. Hands down the most compassionate and thorough veterinarian I have even been to; there's not enough words to express how thankful I am to have found this vet!
Dr. Cooley was awesome! Very thorough

Everyone is always so nice! The receptionist is always so welcoming and the entire team is extremely patient and kind to my nervous rescue pup Lady. I appreciate the reminders and access to communicate via text.

Thank you for taking care of my beloved child and making our visit stress-free. Even my extremely anxious cat was calm and well behaved with the staff here because they were so gentle. The vet was incredibly attentive to my concerns and the pricing was very reasonable. I definitely will be coming back for future vet concerns. Thank you!!

At the risk of sounding like a Karen, I am writing a request - please go somewhere else. I've given them quite a few times to redeem themselves due to their polite nature and convenience but they have misled me on my last pets cremation ( very upsetting to say the least), not honoring the discount I discussed with my pets first visit, and then with a very casual minimal exam told me that they had the best deal with heartworm at $800/ a year due to other places charging for shipping... Walked home, ordered the same medicine online at $80/ a year.
